scope: Static comparison of Alpha2 item kit and no-REGISTER EV/IV candidate; no ROM/core execution.

facts.candidate_behavior: The candidate keeps item 118 fieldUse=5 and changes only its selectable flag; its generated script is an EV/IV/nature-style party editor menu.

finding: Independent source review corrected the initial collision claim. Alpha2 item 118 has fieldUse=0 and acts as a possession marker checked by Bag_TakeItem to retain supported consumables. The EV/IV candidate adds a USE action and appends script 2072 while preserving the previous 72 destinations; it does not replace a pre-existing Cheat Kit USE menu. Reuse must still be tested in the final candidate.
minimum_solution: Preserve the item 118 possession marker and its consumable-reuse hook. A separate editor item implements the requested organization, rather than repairing a proven loss of an existing USE action. The private item 119 candidate requires independent static review, native action/reuse tests and an implemented NPC migration. This review does not prove item 119 globally unused.
limits: No ROM writes, emulator run, or source build performed.
No claim that an unused item ID is safe.
Nature support is not present in the inspected stat_editor_menu_script.py contract; it covers EV/IV families only.
